name: cypht
description: Cypht webmail (multi-account IMAP/JMAP/EWS, RSS feeds, calendar) — webmail.diegonmarcos.com

extra_ports.desc: PostgreSQL — loopback only (cypht co-located via host network)

mail_clients._doc: Cypht-only declarations. Cross-service data (mail server hosts/ports, mailbox identities) is JOINED at engine derive time from peers' build.json (services.<peer>.users + .domain + .ports/extra_ports). Output lands in build-cypht.json#mail_accounts (resolved). The cypht flake reads build-cypht.json and emits dist/assets/seed-accounts.json + dist/assets/cypht-api/configs.json — no hand-written duplicates.

primary_user._doc: Cypht UI master login (Hm_Auth_DB). INDEPENDENT from the mailbox passwords (those come from peers' users{}.pass_env). Cypht-only data — owned by cypht.

via_internal._doc: JMAP via Stalwart. Cypht runs network_mode=host on oci-mail (same VM as Stalwart). Engine resolves service=stalwart, via=jmap_tls → host=jmap.diegonmarcos.com:2443 — reachable inside-VM (Stalwart listens on 10.0.0.3:2443) and externally via Caddy L4 reverse_proxy on jmap.diegonmarcos.com:443.

via_external._doc: External providers (no internal SoT exists). Hosts/ports declared inline because no peer service owns them.
via_external.label: diegonmarcos@livecom | IMAP-outlook

carddav._doc: CardDAV providers. Engine resolves service_ref → services.radicale.domain at derive time.

feeds._doc: RSS feeds. Engine resolves service_ref → services.ntfy.domain. topics_source is a path (relative to cypht src/) to a topics list — itself a build-time copy of the canonical I_cloud-data/ntfy-api/src/topics.json.

profiles._doc: Cypht send-as profiles (Hm_Profiles, modules/profiles). Profile is a CYPHT-ONLY concept — owned by cypht. match_template is rendered after via_internal labels are resolved; engine wires smtp_id/imap_id by name lookup at apply-time.

settings._doc: Per-user UI prefs. Each key MUST end in _setting (Cypht convention). Cypht-only — owned by cypht.
